To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(a) effect sizes can be estimated from a variety of statistics, (b) effect size interpretation is a matter of judgment, (c) effect size interpretations should emphasize direct and explicit comparison of effect sizes in a new study to effect sizes reported in related studies, and (d) effect size interpretations are most informative when they include a discussion of effect size replicability
